semantic_review.method: Содержательная редакторская проверка моделью по 14 реальным ноутбукам и исходному README

javascript_tests.test_dependency: fake-indexeddb 6.2.4 installed from official npm registry with integrity verification

code_execution.limits: Windows Job Object: CPU 5s, memory 1GiB, one process; audit denies filesystem writes; wall-clock timeout 30s; output 1MiB; AST and audit checks; only reviewed new examples

warnings.message: Missing answer; legacy correction may be separate

browser_verification.browser: Codex In-app Browser, desktop Chromium, Windows
checks: exam count 2, early finish rejected, answers after completion
service worker waiting and explicit activation preserve history/session
reload with preview server stopped served cached app
export JSON and reimport three grades with pending session
syntax highlighting and exact code clipboard copy
classic answers hidden before completion; weighted score 9.95 for one simple score 9 and eight scores 10
light/dark, viewport 390 and 1280, no page horizontal overflow in checked screens

limitations: No independent teacher review of theory/proofs
No bulk legacy snippet or full-notebook execution
No real iPhone/Mac Safari/Android installation tests
Local browser data can be cleared; export remains necessary
